meanings.usage: 常用insure sth against...结构，表示为某物投保某种险
指投保人定期支付给保险公司的费用
作名词时指索赔行为；作动词时常用make a claim结构
指从灾难或水中救出财物
通常指船或类似容器的翻转
一种用电力或人力驱动的起重设备
作名词指固定用的工具；作动词指用夹子固定
指处于不稳定或高高在上的位置
指因不平衡而倒下或翻转
强调规模或程度非常大
sink的过去分词作形容词，描述沉入水中的物体
指户外的庆祝活动，通常有各种游戏和义卖

phrases.usage: 愿意做某事，表示乐意或准备做某事

examples.en: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.
examples.zh: 保险公司通常愿意为任何东西保险。

phrases.usage: 如果；万一；倘若，用于引出假设的灾难情况

examples.en: It would be possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.
examples.zh: 如果遇到坏天气，你也可以为自己投保。

phrases.usage: 提出索赔，向保险公司要求赔偿

examples.en: A shipping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging.
examples.zh: 一家航运公司提出了打捞费用的索赔。

examples.en: A local authority to recover the cost of salvaging.
examples.zh: 地方当局为收回打捞费用。

examples.en: The teenagers looked on while three men dived into the water.
examples.zh: 当三个人反复潜水时，青少年们在一旁观看。

examples.en: A powerful winch was put into operation.
examples.zh: 一台大功率绞车被启动运转。

examples.en: It set up a huge wave in the canal.
examples.zh: 它在运河里掀起了一股巨浪。

examples.en: It was almost impossible to attach hawsers to the rim.
examples.zh: 几乎不可能把缆绳系在边缘上。

examples.en: By working at tremendous speed, the men got the dish on to dry land.
examples.zh: 由于以极快的速度工作，这些人把盘子弄到了陆地上。

examples.en: The men were now obliged to try once more.
examples.zh: 这些人现在不得不再次尝试。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + be + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
grammar.definition: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态。被动语态由be动词+过去分词构成。 当不知道动作执行者、强调动作承受者或上下文中不需要提及执行者时使用被动语态。

examples.en: The pie dish was insured for the trip.
examples.zh: 这个馅饼盘被投保了旅途险。

examples.en: The dish was raised to the surface and was drawn towards the canal bank.
examples.zh: 盘子被升到水面并被拖向运河岸边。

grammar.title: It is + not uncommon / not unusual to... (it作形式主语)
grammar.structure: It is + not uncommon / not unusual + to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: it作形式主语代替不定式短语或从句，真正的主语是后面的不定式to结构。这种结构用于表达某种情况并不罕见。 用来表达某事经常发生或并不稀奇，语气较委婉。

examples.en: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim.
examples.zh: 听到航运公司提出索赔是很常见的。

examples.en: It is not unusual to see tourists here in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天这里有游客并不稀奇。

grammar.title: more than + n./adj. (不仅仅；超出)
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词 + more than + 名词/形容词/动词
grammar.definition: more than可以修饰名词、形容词或动词，表示程度'超出'或'不仅仅'的含义。 用于强调数量、程度或性质超出预期或某个界限。

examples.en: Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear.
examples.zh: 跳舞被证明是这只盘子承受不了的。

examples.en: This is more than I can afford.
examples.zh: 这超出了我的能力范围。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词 + for + 目的

original.en: The pie committee decided that the best way to transport the dish would be by canal so they insured it for the trip.
original.zh: 馅饼委员会决定运输这只盘子的最好方式是通过运河，所以他们为旅途投了保。

imitations.en: The company insured the equipment for the experiment.
imitations.zh: 公司为实验设备投了保。

imitations.en: He insured his car for the journey.
imitations.zh: 他为旅途中的汽车投保了。

patterns.pattern: It is + adj. + to + 动词原形

original.en: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim.
original.zh: 听到航运公司提出索赔是很常见的。

imitations.en: It is not unusual to see children playing in the park.
imitations.zh: 看到孩子们在公园里玩耍并不稀奇。

imitations.en: It is essential to understand the importance of insurance.
imitations.zh: 理解保险的重要性是必要的。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/had little difficulty in + doing sth

original.en: They had little difficulty in finding it.
original.zh: 他们找到它没什么困难。

imitations.en: I had little difficulty in solving this problem.
imitations.zh: 我解决这个难题没费什么力气。

imitations.en: She had little difficulty in passing the exam.
imitations.zh: 她通过考试没费什么力气。

patterns.pattern: be + adj. + enough + to + 动词原形

original.en: The dish rose to the surface and was gently drawn towards the canal bank.
original.zh: 盘子升到水面并被轻轻地拖向运河岸边。

imitations.en: The bridge was strong enough to support the weight.
imitations.zh: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受这个重量。

imitations.en: He was tall enough to reach the shelf.
imitations.zh: 他足够高，能够到那个架子。

lines.en: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.
lines.zh: 保险公司一般说来愿意承保一切东西。

lines.en: Insuring public or private property is a standard practice in most countries in the world.
lines.zh: 承办公共财产或私人财产保险是世界上大部分国家的正常业务。

lines.en: If, however, you were holding an open air garden party or a fete it would be equally possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.
lines.zh: 如果你要举办一次露天游园会或盛宴，为避免碰上不好的天气而遭受损失也同样可以保险，不用说，保险公司承担风险越大，你付的保险费也就越高。

lines.en: Needless to say, the bigger the risk an insurance company takes, the higher the premium you will have to pay.
lines.zh: 航运公司为打捞沉船而提出索赔，这是常有的事，但某地当局为打捞一只焙制馅饼的盘子提出索赔，倒是件新鲜的事儿。

lines.en: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim for cost of salvaging a sunken ship.
lines.zh: 这个馅饼盘子确实少见，有18英尺长，6英尺宽。

lines.en: But the claim made by a local authority to recover the cost of salvaging a sunken pie dish must surely be unique.
lines.zh: 某地方当局买下它用来焙制一个巨大的馅饼为一年一度交易会助兴。

lines.en: Admittedly it was an unusual pie dish, for it was eighteen feet long and six feet wide.
lines.zh: 馅饼委员会确认运输这只盘子的最佳方案是通过运河水运。

lines.en: It had been purchased by a local authority so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.
lines.zh: 于是，他们对这只盘子的运输安全投了保。

lines.en: The pie committee decided that the best way to transport the dish would be by canal, so they insured it for the trip.
lines.zh: 盘子下水后不久，馅饼委员会成员们来到当地一家小酒店庆贺。

lines.en: Shortly after it was launched, the pie committee went to a local inn to celebrate.
lines.zh: 就在这个时候，许多十几岁的孩子爬盘子举行他们自己的集会。

lines.en: At the same time, a number of teenagers climbed on to the dish and held a little party of their own.
lines.zh: 他们跳起了舞，盘子难以承受。

lines.en: Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear, for during the party it capsized and sank in seven feet of water.
lines.zh: 舞会进行过程中，盘子倾覆，沉入了7英尺深的水中。

lines.en: The pie committee telephoned a local garage owner who arrived in a recovery truck to salvage the pie dish.
lines.zh: 馅饼委员会给当地汽车修理库老板打电话，他闻讯后开着一辆急修车前来打捞盘子。

lines.en: Shivering in their wet clothes, the teenagers looked on while three men dived repeatedly into the water to locate the dish.
lines.zh: 那些孩子们穿着湿衣服哆嗦，看着3个工人轮潜入水中以确定盘子的位置。

lines.en: They had little difficulty in finding it, but hauling it out of the water proved to be a serious problem.
lines.zh: 他们没费多大事儿就找到了盘子。

lines.en: The sides of the dish were so smooth that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it.
lines.zh: 可是把盘子捞出却是一个很大的难题。

lines.en: Eventually chains were fixed to one end of the dish and a powerful winch was put into operation.
lines.zh: 盘子四边十分光滑，要在盘边拴上绳索或链条而同时又不损坏它是很难办到的。

lines.en: The dish rose to the surface and was gently drawn towards the canal bank.
lines.zh: 不过，他们终于将链条固定在盘子的一端，一台大功率的绞车开动起来。

lines.en: For one agonizing moment, the dish was perched precariously on the bank of the canal, but it suddenly overbalanced and slid back into the water.
lines.zh: 盘子慢慢浮出水面，被轻轻地拽向运河岸边。

lines.en: The men were now obliged to try once more.
lines.zh: 在令人忐忑不安的瞬间，盘子晃晃悠悠地上了岸，但它突然失去了平衡，又跌回水中。

lines.en: This time they fixed heavy metal clamps to both sides of the dish so that they could fasten the chains.
lines.zh: 工人们只得再来一次。

lines.en: The dish now had to be lifted vertically because one edge was resting against the side of the canal.
lines.zh: 这次，他们用沉重的金属夹子把盘子夹住，以便往盘子上安装铁链。

lines.en: The winch was again put into operation and one of the men started up the truck.
lines.zh: 这次，盘子必须垂直吊出水面，因为盘子的一边紧靠着运河河岸。

lines.en: Several minutes later, the dish was again put into operation and one of the water.
lines.zh: 绞盘机再次启动，一位工人发动了急修车的引擎。

lines.en: Water streamed in torrents over its sides with such force that it set up a huge wave in the canal.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，盘子被成功地拽出了水面。波浪从盘子两侧急涌而出，在运河里掀起一股大浪。

lines.en: There was danger that the wave would rebound off the other side of the bank and send the dish plunging into the water again.
lines.zh: 但是当波浪从河对岸折回来时，就有再次把盘子拖进水里的危险。

lines.en: By working at tremendous speed, the men managed to get the dish on to dry land before the wave returned.
lines.zh: 工人们动作迅速，终于赶在那股大浪返回之前把盘子拽到了岸上。

questions.q: Who owned the pie and why?
questions.zh: 这个馅饼归谁所有？为什么？
questions.a: It was bought by a local authority, so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.
questions.aZh: 它由地方当局买下，为的是一年一度的交易会能烤制一个巨型馅饼。
questions.hint: 答案见 It had been purchased by a local authority so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.

questions.q: What size was the unusual pie dish?
questions.zh: 这只不寻常的馅饼盘有多大？
questions.a: It was eighteen feet long and six feet wide.
questions.aZh: 它有十八英尺长、六英尺宽。
questions.hint: 答案见 Admittedly it was an unusual pie dish, for it was eighteen feet long and six feet wide.

questions.q: How did the dish come to sink in the canal?
questions.zh: 盘子是怎样沉入运河的？
questions.a: A number of teenagers climbed on to the dish and held a party; while they were dancing, the dish capsized and sank in seven feet of water.
questions.aZh: 一群十几岁的孩子爬上盘子开起了派对；他们跳舞时盘子倾覆，沉入七英尺深的水中。
questions.hint: 答案见 Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear… it capsized and sank in seven feet of water.

questions.q: What happened during the first attempt to salvage the dish?
questions.zh: 第一次打捞盘子的经过如何？
questions.a: They fixed chains to one end and started a powerful winch; the dish rose and was drawn towards the bank, but for one agonizing moment it perched precariously and suddenly overbalanced, sliding back into the water.
questions.aZh: 他们把链条固定在盘子的一端，开动大功率绞车；盘子浮起被拖向岸边，可在令人忐忑的瞬间它晃晃悠悠地上了岸，突然失去平衡又滑回水中。
questions.hint: 答案见 it perched precariously on the bank… suddenly overbalanced and slid back into the water.

questions.q: Why did the men have to work at tremendous speed at the very end?
questions.zh: 为什么工人们在最后必须争分夺秒地作业？
questions.a: Because the huge wave set up in the canal might rebound off the far bank and plunge the dish into the water again; they had to get it on to dry land before the wave returned.
questions.aZh: 因为盘子上岸时在运河里掀起的大浪可能从对岸折回，把盘子再次拖入水中；他们必须赶在大浪返回之前把盘子拽上干地。
questions.hint: 答案见 There was danger that the wave would rebound… By working at tremendous speed… before the wave returned.

translation:
保险公司一般说来愿意承保一切东西。
承办公共财产或私人财产保险是世界上大部分国家的正常业务。
如果你要举办一次露天游园会或盛宴，为避免碰上不好的天气而遭受损失也同样可以保险，不用说，保险公司承担风险越大，你付的保险费也就越高。
航运公司为打捞沉船而提出索赔，这是常有的事，但某地当局为打捞一只焙制馅饼的盘子提出索赔，倒是件新鲜的事儿。
这个馅饼盘子确实少见，有18英尺长，6英尺宽。
某地方当局买下它用来焙制一个巨大的馅饼为一年一度交易会助兴。
馅饼委员会确认运输这只盘子的最佳方案是通过运河水运。
于是，他们对这只盘子的运输安全投了保。
盘子下水后不久，馅饼委员会成员们来到当地一家小酒店庆贺。
就在这个时候，许多十几岁的孩子爬盘子举行他们自己的集会。
他们跳起了舞，盘子难以承受。
舞会进行过程中，盘子倾覆，沉入了7英尺深的水中。
馅饼委员会给当地汽车修理库老板打电话，他闻讯后开着一辆急修车前来打捞盘子。
那些孩子们穿着湿衣服哆嗦，看着3个工人轮潜入水中以确定盘子的位置。
他们没费多大事儿就找到了盘子。
可是把盘子捞出却是一个很大的难题。
盘子四边十分光滑，要在盘边拴上绳索或链条而同时又不损坏它是很难办到的。
不过，他们终于将链条固定在盘子的一端，一台大功率的绞车开动起来。
盘子慢慢浮出水面，被轻轻地拽向运河岸边。
在令人忐忑不安的瞬间，盘子晃晃悠悠地上了岸，但它突然失去了平衡，又跌回水中。
工人们只得再来一次。
这次，他们用沉重的金属夹子把盘子夹住，以便往盘子上安装铁链。
这次，盘子必须垂直吊出水面，因为盘子的一边紧靠着运河河岸。
绞盘机再次启动，一位工人发动了急修车的引擎。
几分钟后，盘子被成功地拽出了水面。
波浪从盘子两侧急涌而出，在运河里掀起一股大浪。
但是当波浪从河对岸折回来时，就有再次把盘子拖进水里的危险。
工人们动作迅速，终于赶在那股大浪返回之前把盘子拽到了岸上。
title: Fully Insured
subtitle: 全保险

lead.question: 一只十八英尺长的巨型馅饼盘为何沉入运河？打捞费用又由谁来索赔？
lead.warmup: 你知道吗？除了房子和汽车，连一次露天游园会、甚至一只烤巨型馅饼的盘子都能投保。保险公司承担的风险越大，你要付的保险费就越高。本课讲的就是一只十八英尺长的馅饼盘沉入运河后，地方当局如何为打捞费用向保险公司索赔的趣事。学会 insure、premium、claim 等词，你就能读懂真实世界的保险故事。
goals: 掌握 insure / insurance / policy / premium / claim / cover 等保险核心词汇。
理解并运用 the＋比较级，the＋比较级 结构。
掌握过去完成时被动语态（had been purchased / had been insured）。
理解虚拟条件句 if you were holding…, it would be possible to… 的用法。
lead.summary: 保险公司几乎什么都愿承保。某地方当局买下一只十八英尺长、六英尺宽的巨型馅饼盘，为一年一度交易会烤制大馅饼，并为运河运输投保。盘子下水后，一群少年爬上去开舞会，使它倾覆沉入七英尺深水中。打捞一波三折：链条固定的盘子失衡滑回水中，工人加装金属夹子重来，终于赶在大浪折返前把它拖上岸。
lead.tips: 注意 insure（投保、承保）、ensure（确保）、assure（使某人确信）、insurance（保险）拼写相近但含义不同；表示“索赔”要用 make a claim for，介词是 for 而不是 of。

exercises.q: 翻译：保险公司一般说来愿意承保一切东西。
exercises.a: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.

exercises.q: 填空：The bigger the risk an insurance company takes, the higher the ____ you will have to pay.
填空：Before the trip the pie committee took out an insurance ____ for the dish.
句型转换：将“A local authority had purchased the dish.”改为被动语态。
exercises.a: The dish had been purchased by a local authority.
exercises.note: 过去完成时被动：had been done。

exercises.q: 翻译：如果你要举办一次露天游园会，为防遇上坏天气也可以投保。
exercises.a: If you were holding an open air garden party, it would be equally possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.

exercises.q: 改错：It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim of the cost of salvaging a sunken ship.
exercises.a: 将 of 改为 for：…has made a claim for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship.
exercises.note: make a claim for 索赔。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 the＋比较级 改写“If the risk is bigger, you will have to pay a higher premium.”
exercises.a: The bigger the risk, the higher the premium you will have to pay.

quiz.q: “保险公司一般说来愿意承保一切东西”中，“承保”用哪个动词？
“It is not uncommon to hear that…” 中 not uncommon 的意思是？
下面哪一句是被动语态？
options: A local authority had purchased the dish.
The dish had been purchased by a local authority.
A local authority purchased the dish.
The dish purchased a local authority.

quiz.q: The risk was great, so he had to pay a high ____. 选哪个词？
quiz.note: the higher the risk, the higher the premium。

quiz.q: The insurance policy ____ fire and theft. 哪个动词最恰当？
哪一句正确使用 the more…the more… 结构表达“风险越大，保险费越高”？
options: The bigger the risk is, higher the premium you will have to pay.
The bigger the risk, the higher the premium you will have to pay.
The bigger the risk, the high premium you will have to pay.
Bigger the risk, higher the premium you will have to pay.
